## Summary

Describe the focused change and the methodological or reproducibility question it addresses.

## Verification

List the commands that were run and the outcome.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and reviewable.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] `bash scripts/verify_benchmark.sh` was run if pipeline behavior changed.
- [ ] Tracked reports and figures were refreshed if their inputs changed.
- [ ] New inputs are synthetic or clearly documented public aggregate references.
- [ ] No personal data, confidential data, credentials, or organization-specific details were added.
- [ ] Limitations remain explicit and claims do not exceed the evidence.
